summary_fr: Reglage retenu : temperature 0,3 et huit fiches compactes (136 mots). Les lectures sont globalement comparables aux autres candidats, avec un temps median observe de 4,84 s contre 7,05 s pour le recit de 752 mots. Les temperatures 0,6 et 0,9 ne donnent pas un gain qualitatif assez regulier. Tous les candidats gardent des erreurs ponctuelles.
rationale: Keep the revised event-first prompt, which addresses the former repeated technical-memory explanations.
Keep temperature 0.3: increasing it did not consistently improve insight or prevent errors.
Use the compact factual reference for responsiveness and context margin; its eight facets preserve the main documentary handles without supplying ready-made general conclusions.
Keep all longer references and make both temperature and context file configurable and logged.
limits: This is the best practical compromise selected among tested conditions, not a statistically established global optimum.
Screening uses two seeds; each complete walkthrough uses one seed and a rolling memory of its own responses.
Four sequences were interleaved. The detailed-card 0.3 follow-up was run afterward.
The comparison uses frozen game outputs and does not simulate the Godot playback timeline.
Interpretive quality was judged by the coding assistant. Literal keyword counts and embedding diversity are not quality scores.
Occasional unsupported interpretations remain, including in the selected preset.
